description: The music window: YouTube's own page in a frameless ellipse. The page is not ours, so this is a REMOTE capability, limited to YouTube's addresses and to this one window, and to nothing but moving and sizing that window: drag it (start-dragging), take the handle on its rim (start-resize-dragging) and scroll over it to make it bigger or smaller (read its size and position, set both). No events, no opener, no filesystem, no custom commands.
